title: Media Provenance Capture
description: Subject-only capture record: structured metadata and raw C2PA manifest presence detected in a media file at intake time. For use as credentialSubject data or in CMS storage; no Verifiable Credential envelope.

captured_at.description: When the capture run completed (ISO 8601, UTC Z recommended).

source.description: The assessed media asset. Maps to schema:ImageObject / schema:MediaObject fields; see context.json.

original_path_relative.description: Path to the file relative to a storage root, or an absolute path if outside that root.

traditional.description: Reserved for EXIF / IPTC / XMP promotions from the host environment (often empty in early phases).

c2pa.description: C2PA manifest store detection result (read-only; no cryptographic verification in baseline).

manifest_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw manifest store bytes.
